resources.string: Minimalist customizable clock and date widget
Live device battery and internal storage meter
AuraSpace uses Android\'s SET_WALLPAPER permission to apply this artwork cleanly to your Home Screen, Lock Screen, or both without cropping artifacts.

To protect your privacy, AuraSpace uses the zero-permission Android Photo Picker instead of requesting broad gallery access (READ_MEDIA_IMAGES). Only the single image you choose is shared with the app.
Changing screen timeout and system font scale directly from AuraSpace requires Android\'s WRITE_SETTINGS approval. You can grant or revoke this anytime in System Settings.
